segments.title: What the continuous record demands
segments.narration: If you watched from origins to this hour, you saw a state that learned to expand capacity faster than it expanded accountability. The remedy implied by the record is not a single election slogan. It is permanent public memory, continuous audit, and citizen tools that do not wait for permission.

segments.title: Return daily — the film never ends
segments.narration: Bookmark the daily briefing. Re-enter any act. Re-open any source. Share one primary document. This concludes the continuous cut of the LIRIL Canada film — until the next open record lands.
